title: Pre-Market — Tuesday, November 10, 2026
html:
Inflation day: SPY waits above the line while Waller puts a bigger hike on the table.

Here's what I'm seeing before the bell. Futures are flat, oil is sliding again, and everything waits on the 8:30 a.m. inflation report (CPI).

The one thing

SPY is at $753.37 pre-market, holding above the $745 line it took back yesterday. CPI at 8:30 decides whether that line holds.

Why it matters: Fed Governor Waller said this morning a half-point rate hike in December “should be considered” if core inflation stays hot. A soft core number (0.2% or less) keeps SPY above $745 and turns on the SPY call idea. A hot one (0.3% or more) puts $745 at risk and makes waiting the right move.

Overnight in plain words

  • Futures: S&P 500 about +0.1%, Nasdaq 100 about −0.2%, Dow about +0.4%. Flat, waiting on CPI after Monday’s 2.4% jump.
  • Asia and Europe: Japan’s Nikkei +2.9%, Hong Kong +0.4%, Shanghai about flat. Europe is trading a little higher.
  • Oil: down again. WTI about $84.60 (−2.6%), Brent about $89.90 (−2.9%), on hopes for US–Iran talks. Brent was above $115 in late October.
  • Rates and fear: 10-year yield about 4.86%, little changed. The VIX, the market’s fear gauge, is near 20, calm for a CPI morning.
  • Headlines: Waller (above) keeps December hike odds over 80%. Nvidia’s board review of its CEO continues; NVDA is flat pre-market at $178.41. Anthropic is reported to be moving ahead with an IPO, which keeps attention on AI.

SPY at the open

Ladder (from last night's Debrief):

  • Oct 6 record high: $781.62
  • Ceiling · 61.8% + 20- & 50-day: $762–765
  • 50% of the drop · Monday’s stall: $757.17
  • PRE-MARKET: $753.37
  • Support · 38.2% of the drop: $751.39
  • The line · old floor: $744–745
  • Nov 5 low: $732.71
  • Big floor · 200-day + 38.2% of run: $722–728
  • 50% of the Mar–Oct run: $703.87
  • If SPY opens above $757.17… it has cleared the 50% line of the Oct–Nov drop that stopped it yesterday. The SPY $775 call condition (above $745 after CPI) is met, but the next ceiling is $762–765, so let it hold for 30 minutes before acting.
  • If it holds between $745 and $757… the reclaim is holding. That’s the SPY call setup. The best entry is a dip that holds $751.39 (38.2% of the drop), not a chase into $757.
  • If it opens below $745… the reclaim failed and the SPY call idea goes on hold. $732.71 (the Nov 5 low) is next, then the $722–728 floor. No new longs.

Movers on your list (Watchlist)

  • BE $190.00 (−2.0%): Giving back part of Monday’s 11.9% jump. It’s between your 0.786 extension ($156.28, the floor) and your 1.382 ($227.97). No plan change.
  • DAL $92.32 (+0.6%): Oil is down again, which helps airlines. It’s above $91.86 (target 1, already hit) and heading toward target 2 at $95.18, which is also its 52-week high. Plan: hold the open $90 call; the stop stays a close below $83.
  • PLTR $168.00 (−0.7%): Quiet. Still $4.23 under the $172.23 call trigger. No change: wait for the trigger, don’t buy under it.
  • V $426.49 (+1.0%): Above your 2.382 extension ($423.52). Next is your 2.618 at $442.75, where it stalled the week of Nov 2. A weekly close decides it.
  • XOM $164.09 (−0.4%): Oil down again. Still under your 2.0 extension ($166.89), now resistance. Your 1.618 at $159.09 is next support.
  • Everything else on the watchlist is within 1–2%. BA $172.91 (+0.3%), DELL $346.00 (−0.1%), SMH $483.96 (−0.7%) and NOW $103.03 (+0.3%) are quiet; the BA, DELL and SMH downside ideas are unchanged and far from their levels. AMZN $267.70 sits between your 2.382 ($264.43) and 2.618 ($275.22) extensions.

Today's calendar

  • 8:30 a.m.: October CPI. Forecast: +0.3% for the month (September +0.6%), core +0.2% (September +0.3%). There’s no year-over-year figure this time, because the 2025 shutdown stopped price collection in October 2025.
  • Fed: Waller spoke in London this morning (the 50-point remark). Logan, Schmid and Bowman are also on this week’s calendar. Anything they say about CPI can move SPY.
  • Earnings: After the close: CoreWeave (an AI cloud name; it can move NVDA, SMH and the AI group tonight), D-Wave and Rigetti. Also today: TransDigm, Sea, On Holding, eToro. No watchlist name reports today, so no IV-crush risk tonight.
  • Ahead: Tomorrow (Nov 11, Veterans Day) stocks are open but the bond market is closed. NVDA reports Nov 17, DELL Nov 24: holding their options through the report risks IV crush, the drop in option prices once the news is out.

Plays check (Options Playbook)

  • DAL Dec 18 $90 call · OPEN — Still valid · IV 41% vs moves 37% → FAIR. Entry $632.50, last night’s mark $597.50. DAL at $92.32 adds roughly $30 by my estimate (delta 0.61; verify in Webull). Target 2 $95.18. Exit on DAL below $83. (OI 3,154 · vol 1,436 · bid/ask $5.80/$6.15 (last close))
  • HLT Dec 18 $380 call · OPEN — Still valid · IV 24% vs moves 23% → FAIR. HLT $376.30 pre-market (very thin trading). Marked $990 last night. Exit on a close below $359.41; targets $385.93, $399.73. Thin options: use limit orders only. (OI 279 · vol 6 · bid/ask $8.00/$11.80 (last close; fails the liquidity rule for new money))
  • SPY Dec 18 $775 call · WATCHING — Closer to triggering · IV 14% vs moves 15% → FAIR. The condition is SPY above $745 after today’s CPI. Pre-market it’s $753.37. If CPI is soft and SPY holds above $745, it triggers. Exit below $732; targets $757, then $762–765. (OI 44,459 · vol 30,078 · bid/ask $6.08/$6.14 (last close))
  • PLTR Dec 18 $180 call · WATCHING — Wait · IV 49% vs moves 50% → FAIR. PLTR $168.00, $4.23 under the $172.23 trigger. Exit on a close below $158; targets $182.77, then $185.5–190. A hot CPI hurts high-valuation names like PLTR most. (OI 8,420 · vol 1,363 · bid/ask $6.70/$7.10 (last close))
  • BA Dec 18 $170 put · WATCHING — Wait · IV 33% vs moves 36% → FAIR. BA $172.91. Trigger: below $165, or a failed rally into $179–181.5. Exit on a close above $185; targets $156.34, $147.61. (OI 4,072 · vol 228 · bid/ask $5.60/$6.00 (last close))
  • No new plays: nothing overnight created a fresh setup. Option quotes are last night’s close; options don’t trade pre-market.

Alerts for today

  • SPY — price crosses below $745.00 → the reclaim failed after CPI; SPY call idea on hold
  • SPY — price crosses above $757.17 → the 50% line is cleared; next ceiling $762–765
  • PLTR — price crosses above $172.23 → call trigger for the $180 call
  • BA — price crosses below $165.00 → put trigger for the $170 put
  • DAL — price crosses above $95.18 → target 2 for the open $90 call, take profits (keep the below-$83 stop alert)

An alert means look now, not buy now.

Opening rule: Don’t trade the first CPI reaction.

CPI lands an hour before the bell, so the open will already carry a gap. First reactions often reverse. Let the first 30 minutes settle: if SPY is still above $745 at 10:00, the reclaim is real. Then use a limit order at the mid; spreads widen in the first minutes of a news day.

Sources: Yahoo Finance: Stock market today, Nov 10; TipRanks: Markets await the consumer inflation report; Yahoo Finance UK: Wall Street futures mixed as investors await CPI; Stocktwits: Waller says a 50-point hike should be considered

Education, not personalized investment advice. Claude never places trades; check every quote in Webull before acting.
